$comment: VS Code MCP config for the intranet Confluence connector.
Merge into your USER mcp.json (Command Palette > MCP: Open User Configuration,
i.e. ~/Library/Application Support/Code/User/mcp.json) so it works in every workspace.
If that file already has servers, add these entries instead of overwriting it.
Then replace the absolute path and the CONFLUENCE_BASE_URL host.
The token is prompted for and stored by VS Code, never written to this file.
